source: Composited from the author's transparent layers by tools/compose_word.py — floor, each tile in a regular and a lit state, an open hand and three pointing hands. No frame of hers is reconciled against another, so nothing can drift: the floor is one image that never moves and an untouched tile is the same file every time. Letters STAY LIT once touched, so the word builds. The finger travels because she supplied three pointing poses.

states.why: nothing lit, finger coming in on the first tile
«Ма» begins — М lights under the finger
the А of «Ма» — finger moves on, М stays lit
the fourth: the whole word is lit and holds through the pause
«Мама!» — he lifts his finger clear and the word stands on its own
